title: Fleet by chat: add a drone, replace a part, set spare stock
goal: The owner adds drones and parts and sets stock from chat
acceptance: fleet.chat understands Italian and English phrases such as "nuovo drone Ghost, frame Apex 5, motori XING2 2207 1750KV" (adds the drone, its parts by position and a spares record at 0 for each new model), "sostituito motore anteriore sinistro di Smoke con …" (marks the old part removed, installs the new one, adds its spares record if new), and "ho 3 motori XING2 nuovi" / "2 usati" (sets new/used counts)
Uses the same src/fleet.ts functions as the fleet import (F-098-T05), gated like the other fleet writes (write-local)
Ambiguous phrases ask instead of guessing; tests use invented drones
privacy: Owner fleet data stays local-only; tests use invented drones and generic parts.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Owner approved 2026-11-23 with an estimate of 2 h agent: chat phrases for add drone, replace part and set stock over the F-098-T05 functions. Not a measurement.
